title: 5,10-Methylenetetrahydrofolate reductase genotype determines the plasma homocysteine-lowering effect of supplementation with 5-methyltetrahydrofolate or folic acid in healthy young women
authors: Fohr IP, Prinz-Langenohl R, Brönstrup A, Bohlmann AM, Nau H, Berthold HK, et al.
inKindSupport: Knoll-BioResearch, S Antonino, Switzerland, kindly supplied the 5-methyltetrahydrofolate as a crystalline powder.
result: Results read from the published abstract. Folic acid 400 µg, an equimolar 480 µg of racemic 5-methyltetrahydrofolate, or placebo daily. Folic acid lowered homocysteine by 13% or more in all three MTHFR 677 genotypes at 4 and 8 weeks, most (20%) in TT at 4 weeks. 5-Methyl-THF lowered homocysteine significantly only in CT at 4 weeks (7%); the largest, non-significant fall (15%) was in TT. The authors conclude that in CT and CC women folic acid lowered homocysteine more than 5-methyl-THF.
